dialogue.content: こんばんは。本日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for joining me today.

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: 始めさせていただいて大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.English: May we begin?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お願い致します。
dialogue.English: Please, go ahead.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm your counselor.

dialogue.content: こんばんは
dialogue.English: Good evening.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 職場の人間関係で悩んでいます
dialogue.English: I'm struggling with relationships at work.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お辛いですね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be difficult for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: はじめに、年齢と性別をお聞かせいただけますか？
dialogue.English: To start, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: ２８歳　女です
dialogue.English: I'm 28, female.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。この相談ではどのようにお呼びしたらよいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. How would you like me to address you in this session?

dialogue.content: ゆみ　でお願いします
dialogue.English: Please call me Yumi.

dialogue.content: ゆみさんですね。ありがとうございます。職場でのお話、もう少し詳しく聞かせていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Yumi, thank you. Could you tell me a bit more about what's happening at work?

dialogue.content: 病院で働いているんですが、先生が怖くて
dialogue.English: I work at a hospital, and I'm scared of the doctor.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それは辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: That must be very difficult.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 怖いというのは、具体的にどういう感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: When you say you're scared, what is it like specifically?

dialogue.content: 良く怒られます
dialogue.English: I get scolded a lot.

dialogue.content: 個人の医院なので、
dialogue.English: It's a private clinic, so...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: そういう対応をされると、委縮してしまいますよね・・・
dialogue.English: When you're treated like that, it's natural to feel intimidated...

dialogue.content: 医療事務兼補佐をしてるんですが
dialogue.English: I work as a medical clerk and assistant.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 直接先生から指導があるんですが、
dialogue.English: I receive instructions directly from the doctor, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: さっぱりついていけなくて
dialogue.English: I just can't keep up at all.

dialogue.content: 怒られるのが怖いです
dialogue.English: and I'm afraid of being scolded.

dialogue.content: なるほど・・・指導の厳しい先生なのですね。
dialogue.English: I see... so he's a very strict doctor when it comes to instruction.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でも、怒らなくても・・・と思ってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: But you can't help thinking he doesn't have to get angry about it...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ゆみさんは先生が起こることについて、どう思われますか？
dialogue.English: How do you feel about the doctor getting angry?

dialogue.content: 怒る　です。
dialogue.English: I meant 'angry.'

dialogue.content: 先生の言葉が、難しいと感じています
dialogue.English: I find the doctor's words difficult to understand.

dialogue.content: 先生の説明が理解しづらい、という感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So it feels like the doctor's explanations are hard to follow?

dialogue.content: はい、そんな感じです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's how it feels.

dialogue.content: 一回で聞き取れなくて
dialogue.English: I can't catch everything the first time he says it.

dialogue.content: なるほど。それでは指導を受けても、どう改善したらよいかわかりませんよね。
dialogue.English: I see. In that case, even when you receive instructions, it must be hard to know how to improve.

dialogue.content: イライラ
dialogue.English: He gets irritated.

dialogue.content: されています
先生のそういう反応を見ると、ドキドキしてしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: Seeing him react that way must make your heart pound.

dialogue.content: はい、硬直状態です
dialogue.English: Yes, I just freeze up.

dialogue.content: そうなってしまいますよね・・・　精神的につらい状況ですね。
dialogue.English: That's an understandable reaction... It sounds like a mentally draining situation.

dialogue.content: はい。性格も波長も
dialogue.English: Yes. In terms of personality and chemistry,

dialogue.content: 合わないと感じています
dialogue.English: I feel we don't mesh.

dialogue.content: なるほど。そういう先生と毎日過ごすのは苦痛ですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It must be painful to spend every day with a doctor like that.

dialogue.content: このような状況はもう長く続いているのですか？
dialogue.English: Has this situation been going on for a long time?

dialogue.content: 一年くらいです
dialogue.English: For about a year.

dialogue.content: そんなに長く・・・　ずいぶんと我慢されてきたのですね。
dialogue.English: That long... You've been putting up with it for quite some time.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ゆみさん、体調などはいかがですか？睡眠はとれていますか？
dialogue.English: Yumi, how is your health? Are you sleeping well?

dialogue.content: はい、睡眠は大丈夫ですが、出勤時は緊張でお腹が緩くなります
dialogue.English: Yes, I sleep fine, but when I go to work, I get so nervous I have an upset stomach.

dialogue.content: 痛くもなります
dialogue.English: It becomes painful, too.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか・・・ずいぶんストレスがかかっているご様子で、少し心配です。
dialogue.English: I see... It sounds like you're under a lot of stress, and I'm a bit concerned.

dialogue.content: 職場でご相談できる方はいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anyone at work you can talk to about this?

dialogue.content: あまり居ないです
dialogue.English: Not really.

dialogue.content: 他の人は上手く会話されているので。
dialogue.English: Because the other people seem to get along with him just fine.

dialogue.content: 先生と。
dialogue.English: With the doctor.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。ほかの方はうまく対応されているように思うのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you feel that everyone else handles him well.

dialogue.content: はい、失敗しても、何故か自分には厳しいです。
dialogue.English: Yes, and even if they make a mistake, for some reason, he's especially strict with me.

dialogue.content: 職場ではゆみさんだけが先生とうまく関われない、というふうにお感じなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Do you feel that you're the a only one at work who can't get along with the doctor?

dialogue.content: なるほど・・・ゆみさんだけ、という感じなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see... so you feel like it's only you.

dialogue.content: はい。先生も多分私が苦手だと・・。
dialogue.English: Yes. I think the doctor probably finds me difficult to deal with...

dialogue.content: そのように感じておられるのですね。
dialogue.English: That's how you're feeling.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どういう点で、先生はゆみさんのことを苦手だと思っておられるんでしょうね？
dialogue.English: What makes you think the doctor finds you difficult to deal with?

dialogue.content: 何かこころあたりはありますか？
dialogue.English: Does anything come to mind?

dialogue.content: 苦手というか嫌いかもです。上手におだてたり出来ないからでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Maybe it's not just that he finds me difficult—he might dislike me. Perhaps it's because I can't flatter him skillfully.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。ほかの方はそういう対応でうまくされているんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. And the others manage to get by with that kind of approach.

dialogue.content: 皆が皆ってことではないですが、上手くやってる人はおだてている。自分とは壁を感じます。
dialogue.English: It's not everyone, but the ones who get along well with him are the ones who flatter him. I feel like there's a wall between us.

dialogue.content: だから意地悪をされます
dialogue.English: That's why he's mean to me.

dialogue.content: 先生に。
dialogue.English: By the doctor.

dialogue.content: そうですか・・・うまくおだてないと意地悪をされるって、なんだか理不尽ですね。
dialogue.English: I see... being treated meanly because you don't flatter him, that seems quite unreasonable.

dialogue.content: はい。好き嫌いで態度が違うと感じてます
dialogue.English: Yes. I feel like he treats people differently based on his personal likes and dislikes.

dialogue.content: 上司のそういう対応は納得いかないですよね。
dialogue.English: It's hard to accept that kind of behavior from a superior, isn't it?

dialogue.content: もう長い間耐えてこられていますが、ゆみさんとしてはこれからどうしていきたいと思われますか？
dialogue.English: You've endured this for a long time, but what would you like to do from here on, Yumi?

dialogue.content: 複雑です。辞めたい気持ちと
dialogue.English: It's complicated. Part of me wants to quit,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 転職もまた大変なので
dialogue.English: but changing jobs would be difficult too.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。
dialogue.English: That's true.

dialogue.content: しんどいまま
dialogue.English: so I just keep struggling on as I am.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 今日は先生、機嫌いいかなって。だけど波長も合わないし
dialogue.English: I'm always wondering, 'Is the doctor in a good mood today?' But our chemistry just doesn't match,

dialogue.content: 険悪な空気や聞こえないふりをされるのが、
dialogue.English: and the hostile atmosphere and him pretending not to hear me...

dialogue.content: しんどいです
dialogue.English: is exhausting.

dialogue.content: 失敗したら怒られる、の繰り返し
dialogue.English: It's a cycle of making a mistake and getting yelled at.

dialogue.content: 聞こえないふりもされるんですか・・・そこまでいくともう指導ではないですね。
dialogue.English: He pretends not to hear you, too? At that point, that's not instruction anymore, is it?

dialogue.content: です。
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: そんなふうに毎日顔色をみて働くのも、疲れますね。
dialogue.English: It must be tiring to work every day while having to read his mood like that.

dialogue.content: でも、これまで頑張ってきたのには何か理由があるのではないですか？
dialogue.English: But you must have had a reason for enduring it for so long, haven't you?

dialogue.content: 独学で医療事務取って、
dialogue.English: I studied on my own to get my medical office administration certification, and...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 仕事内容は好きだからです
dialogue.English: ...it's because I like the work itself.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。努力してつかんだ自分の仕事ですもんね。そう簡単には手放せないですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It's a job you worked hard to get. It's not something you can easily let go of, is it?

dialogue.content: 好きな仕事だから、厳しい指導にもこたえようと頑張ってこられたのですね。
dialogue.English: Because you like the job, you've tried your best to meet his strict expectations.

dialogue.content: 他の人はそんな理由で辞めそうにないから
dialogue.English: Because other people don't seem like they would quit for a reason like this.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ほかの人が辞めないのに、自分だけ辞めるのは悔しいですよね。
dialogue.English: It would feel frustrating to be the only one quitting when no one else is, right?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今は、辞めたいくらいつらいけれど、でも好きな仕事だから本当は辞めたくない、というお気持ちでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So right now, it's so tough you want to quit, but because you like the job, you really don't want to, is that right?

dialogue.content: はい、そうです。
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: このまま辞めてしまうのは悔しいですもんね。何かできることはないか考えたいですね。
dialogue.English: It would be a shame to quit like this. I'd like for us to think about if there's anything that can be done.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今の状況を少しでもよくするために、どんなことができそうでしょうか・・・　職場の方に相談してみるとか、どうですか？
dialogue.English: To make the current situation even a little bit better, what do you think could be done? For example, how about talking to someone at work?

dialogue.content: 職場の人と先生の話はしますし、
dialogue.English: I do talk with my coworkers about the doctor, and...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 同じように、怖いとか、失敗して自信ないって言うけど、
dialogue.English: They say similar things, like he's scary or that they lack confidence after making a mistake, but...

dialogue.content: 明らかに楽しく先生は笑って会話してるんですよね・・。
dialogue.English: ...it's clear that the doctor enjoys laughing and talking with them.

dialogue.content: 私とは違って
dialogue.English: Unlike with me.

dialogue.content: そうですか・・・どういうことなんでしょうね。先生のお気持ちがよくわかりませんね。
dialogue.English: I see... I wonder what that's about. It's difficult to understand what the doctor is thinking.

dialogue.content: 自分にコミュニケーション能力が無いのかなとも、思います
dialogue.English: It makes me think that maybe I'm the one who lacks communication skills.

dialogue.content: ゆみさんは、お世辞を言ったりするのは苦手だとおっしゃっていましたね。
dialogue.English: Yumi, you mentioned that you're not good at flattery.

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes,

dialogue.content: 必ずしもお世辞を言う必要はないと、私は思うのですが・・・
dialogue.English: I don't think flattery is necessarily required, though...

dialogue.content: お話をお聞きしていて、私が感じたことを少しお伝えしてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: As I've been listening to you, would it be alright if I shared something I've noticed?

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes,

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: ゆみさんは、先生の厳しい指導や理不尽な対応にずいぶんとつらい思いをされてきましたよね。
dialogue.English: Yumi, you've been through a very difficult time with the doctor's strict guidance and unreasonable behavior.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: でも、辞めたいくらいつらいけれど、好きな仕事だから本当は辞めたくないと思っておられます。
dialogue.English: But even though it's painful enough to make you want to quit, you feel you don't really want to because you like your job.

dialogue.content: 先生がゆみさんに厳しい態度をとられる理由も、なんとなくわかっている感じですよね。
dialogue.English: It sounds like you have some sense of why the doctor takes such a strict attitude toward you.

dialogue.content: でもゆみさんはお世辞とかはどうしても言えない・・・
dialogue.English: But you just can't bring yourself to flatter him...

dialogue.content: もしかして嫌いなタイプかもって思ったりしてます
dialogue.English: I've started to think I might just be the type of person he dislikes.

dialogue.content: 嫌われているんじゃないかって、思っておられるのですね。
dialogue.English: So you're feeling that you might be disliked by him.

dialogue.content: お世辞いう程心やすくなれなくて、先生だから。
dialogue.English: I can't be casual enough with him to flatter him, because he's the doctor.

dialogue.content: 嫌われてると思ってます
dialogue.English: I believe he dislikes me.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。先生に対して尊敬する気持ちがあるからこそ、気さくな態度ではなく、きちんとした態度で接しておられるんだと思います。
dialogue.English: That makes sense. It's precisely because you have respect for him as the doctor that you interact with him formally, rather than casually.

dialogue.content: いつ、辞めるっていうのか、待たれてると思う程、ギクシャクを感じてる
dialogue.English: I feel such a strain between us, to the point where I think he's just waiting for me to say I'm quitting.

dialogue.content: 壁のような溝のような・・。
dialogue.English: Like there's a wall or a gulf between us...

dialogue.content: 先生はゆみさんが辞めるのを待っているのでしょうか？どうなんでしょうね・・・
dialogue.English: I wonder if the doctor is waiting for you to quit. It's hard to say...

dialogue.content: 個人経営ということでしたから、辞めさせることは比較的簡単にできるようにも思います。
dialogue.English: Since you mentioned it's a private practice, I would think it would be relatively easy for him to let you go.

dialogue.content: そう思いながら、嘘であって欲しいと。
dialogue.English: I think so too, but I hope it's not true.

dialogue.content: そう思いますよね。
dialogue.English: Of course you would.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 細い糸にぶら下がってる感じです
dialogue.English: I feel like I'm hanging by a thin thread.

dialogue.content: 不安でいっぱいですよね。思ったのですが、一度先生に今ここで話したようなゆみさんの気持ちを伝えてみるというのはどうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You must be full of anxiety. It's just a thought, but what about trying to tell the doctor how you feel, just as you've told me here?

dialogue.content: 無理です。怖いです。多弁にやられます。やる気あんのかって言われます
dialogue.English: I can't. I'm scared. He'd overwhelm me verbally. He'd just say, 'Do you even have any motivation?'

dialogue.content: だったら言わずに辞めた方がマシかな
dialogue.English: In that case, it might be better to just quit without saying anything.

dialogue.content: うーん、そういうふうに返答がくると、たしかに怖いですよね。
dialogue.English: Mmm, if he responded that way, it would certainly be frightening.

dialogue.content: そこまで恐怖が勝るのであれば、無理にお話する必要はないとも思います。
dialogue.English: If the fear is that overwhelming, I don't think you need to force yourself to talk to him.

dialogue.content: 先生は口が達者なので、私は緊張で無口なので
dialogue.English: The doctor is a very smooth talker, and I get so nervous I become silent.

dialogue.content: 口では先生が上なんですね。
dialogue.English: So he has the upper hand when it comes to words.

dialogue.content: その溝が中々です
dialogue.English: That gap is hard to bridge.

dialogue.content: 勿論です
dialogue.English: Of course.

dialogue.content: なるほど・・・もしかしてその溝は埋まらないかも、と思われているのですね。
dialogue.English: I see... so you're feeling that maybe that gap can't be closed.

dialogue.content: はい、怒るときは何十倍、だから聞こえないふりが怖くて
dialogue.English: Yes, when he gets angry, it's many times worse. That's why it's so scary when he pretends not to hear me.

dialogue.content: それは怖いですね。
dialogue.English: That is scary.

dialogue.content: 私はゆみさんが今以上にストレスを抱えて体調を崩されることが心配です。
dialogue.English: I'm worried that you'll take on even more stress and your health will suffer.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: やめることも、続けることも、ゆみさんが自分で決めたのならそれが正解だと思います。
dialogue.English: Whether you decide to quit or to stay, I believe that whatever you decide for yourself is the right answer.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今すぐに決める必要はありませんが、ゆみさん自身の気持ちと、そして身体の状態をしっかり観察して、
dialogue.English: You don't have to decide right away, but please pay close attention to your own feelings and your physical condition,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 体調がすぐれないな、と思ったら無理は禁物です。
dialogue.English: and if you feel unwell, please don't push yourself.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: お休みするなど、すぐに対応してくださいね。
dialogue.English: Please take immediate action, like taking a day off.

dialogue.content: 今日のご相談で解決策をお伝え出来なくてごめんなさい。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry I couldn't provide a solution for you today.

dialogue.content: 聴いてもらって少しは楽になりました。
dialogue.English: Just having you listen has made me feel a little better.

dialogue.content: そう言っていただけてうれしいです。
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear you say that.

dialogue.content: 今日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for today.

dialogue.content: 今日はそろそろお時間になりますが、またいつでも相談に来てください。
dialogue.English: Our time is almost up for today, but please feel free to come and talk anytime.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: あまり無理をせずに・・・好きな仕事をやっていってくださいね。応援しています。
dialogue.English: Please don't push yourself too hard... and continue doing the work that you love. I'm rooting for you.

dialogue.content: 今日はお話を聞かせてくださってありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing your story with me today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。失礼いたしますね。
dialogue.English: Thank you. Goodbye for now.

dialogue.content: （時間がオーバーしてしまい、申し訳ありませんでした）
dialogue.English: (I'm sorry we went over time.)

dialogue.content: （勉強になりました。ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (This was a great learning experience. Thank you.)

dialogue.content: (いえいえ。大丈夫です終了で
dialogue.English: (No, not at all. It's fine—we can end here.)

dialogue.content: （終わらせていただきますね）
dialogue.English: (I'll end the session now.)

dialogue.content: お願いします)
dialogue.English: (Please do.)
